Quick self-check

Is Your Hair Fall Normal?

How much hair fall is normal?
Losing 50 to 100 hairs a day is normal. If you're seeing clumps in the shower, a thinner ponytail or hair all over your pillow, it's worth getting checked.
The gentle pull test
Gently pull a small bunch of about 50 to 60 hairs from root to tip. If more than 5 or 6 come out easily, you may be shedding more than normal.
Signs it's pattern hair loss
A receding hairline, a thinning crown or a widening part that slowly gets worse over months or years usually points to pattern hair loss rather than temporary shedding.
When to see a doctor soon
Sudden patches of hair loss, a painful or very itchy scalp, or hair loss with tiredness, weight changes or irregular periods all need a doctor's check.

Be honest with yourself

What Stage Is Your Hair Loss?

Hair loss follows typical patterns in men and women. Tap the stage closest to yours to see what treatment can realistically do.

Stages 1–2: slight recession at the temples or a softer hairline. Most follicles are still active.

  • The best time to start treatment
  • PRP, exosomes or QR678 plus prescribed medication
  • Usually 4 to 6 sessions

Stages 3–4: a deeper M-shaped hairline and/or a thinning crown, with scalp showing through.

  • Still very treatable
  • GFC or exosomes with prescribed medication
  • A longer course, then maintenance

Stages 5–7: large bald areas on top. Follicles in shiny, bald areas have usually stopped.

  • Injections can protect the hair that's left
  • Bald areas usually need a hair transplant
  • We'll explain your options honestly

Early thinning: a slightly wider part and less volume on top.

  • Check iron, thyroid, vitamin D and hormones
  • Exosomes, PRP or QR678
  • Usually 4 to 6 sessions

Visible thinning: the part is clearly wider and the scalp shows on top.

  • Treat the root cause first
  • GFC or exosomes, sometimes combined
  • Home treatment if prescribed

Marked thinning: widespread thinning across the top of the head.

  • A combined medical and regenerative plan
  • Realistic goals: thicker coverage and less fall
  • Regular progress photos

Why hair falls

Common Causes of Hair Loss

Treating the cause is just as important as treating the hair. Tap each to learn more.

Genetics and hormones
Pattern hair loss in men and women is driven by genes and the hormone DHT, which slowly shrinks follicles.
Low iron, vitamin D or B12
Very common in Kerala, especially in women. Low levels weaken hair and increase shedding.
Thyroid problems
Both underactive and overactive thyroid can cause diffuse hair fall.
PCOS and hormone changes
PCOS, pregnancy, childbirth and menopause can all trigger thinning or shedding.
Stress, illness and crash diets
Fever, COVID, surgery, severe stress or rapid weight loss can push many hairs into shedding 2 to 3 months later.
Scalp problems
Dandruff, infections and inflammation weaken the scalp environment and worsen hair fall.
Hair styling and chemicals
Tight hairstyles, frequent straightening, colouring and bleaching damage hair and roots.

Myths vs facts

Hair Loss Myths, Busted

"Oiling every day stops hair fall."
Oiling softens hair but doesn't fix hormones, deficiencies or genetics. Too much oil can worsen dandruff.
"Hair loss only affects older men."
Many people start thinning in their 20s, and women get hair loss too.
"Cutting hair makes it grow thicker."
Trimming removes split ends but doesn't change the number or thickness of hairs.
"Once it's gone, nothing helps."
Weak, thinning hair can often be revived. Only fully bald areas usually need a transplant.
"Results show in a few weeks."
Hair grows about 1 cm a month. Real changes take 3 to 6 months.

Questions

Hair Treatment FAQs

Which hair treatment is best for hair fall?
It depends on the cause. For many people, PRP, exosomes or QR678 work well, but finding the cause first, like low iron, thyroid problems or stress, is just as important. Our doctors examine your scalp and suggest blood tests before recommending a treatment.
What hair treatments does Facelit offer?
We offer exosome hair treatment, GFC (growth factor concentrate), PRP for hair and QR678, along with scalp treatments and nutrition support.
GFC vs PRP: which is better?
Both use your own blood. GFC is more concentrated and cell-free, so it often gives stronger, more consistent results with less swelling. PRP is a proven, good-value first step for early hair fall.
Exosomes vs PRP: what's the difference?
PRP comes from your own blood. Exosomes are a ready-made, concentrated product, so no blood draw is needed. Many people do well combining them.
Can hair grow back on a bald patch?
Regenerative treatments work on follicles that are still alive, even if weak. Smooth, shiny bald areas usually can't regrow with injections. A hair transplant may be the better option there.
How many sessions will I need?
Most hair treatments need 4 to 6 sessions, 3 to 4 weeks apart, then maintenance every 3 to 6 months. QR678 is often 6 to 8 sessions.
When will I see results?
Hair fall usually slows within 1 to 2 months. New baby hairs often appear by 3 months, and thicker hair shows around 4 to 6 months.
Is hair loss treatment painful?
Most people feel only mild pricks. We can use numbing cream, and options like QR678 use very fine, shallow injections.
Do hair treatments work for women?
Yes. Female pattern thinning, postpartum shedding and stress-related hair fall all respond well, especially when we treat causes like low iron, thyroid problems and PCOS.
Does dandruff cause hair loss?
Severe dandruff and scalp inflammation can make hair fall worse. Treating the scalp is often the first step.
Can premature greying be reversed?
Usually not. Early greying is mostly genetic. Correcting deficiencies like B12 or thyroid problems may slow it, but no treatment reliably turns grey hair dark again.
Where can I get hair treatment in Kerala?
Facelit offers hair treatments at our clinics in Trivandrum (Kowdiar), Karunagappally (Kollam) and Guruvayur (Thrissur).
How much does hair treatment cost?
It depends on the treatment and number of sessions. Packages offer better value. Book a consultation for a clear, personalised quote.
